## 2. Core Service Offerings

### TV Wall Mounting & Cable Management
- Professional mounting for all TV sizes (32" to 85"+).
- Safe installation on all wall types: drywall, wood studs, plaster & lath, brick, stone, concrete, and metal studs (high-rises).
- In-wall cable concealment meeting NY electrical standards.
- External cord cover raceways for budget-friendly cable management.
- Soundbar mounting and device shelf setup (Apple TV, cable box, gaming consoles).

### Furniture Assembly
- Expert flat-pack assembly for IKEA, Wayfair, Amazon, West Elm, Pottery Barn, Article, and Crate & Barrel.
- Specialized IKEA assembly: PAX wardrobe systems with sliding/hinged doors & drawers, MALM dressers, KALLAX shelving, NORDLI storage beds, and BESTÅ media units.
- Apartment, condo, and co-op assembly in building restriction environments.
- Outdoor furniture & patio set assembly.

### Drywall Repair & Wall Restoration
- Invisible patching for small nail holes, doorknob punctures, ceiling cracks, and large drywall cutouts.
- Texture matching: smooth, orange peel, knockdown, and skip trowel finishes.
- Plaster wall repair for historic Westchester homes.
- Water damage wall restoration and drywall replacing.
- Final paint coat matching included with repair service.

### Interior Painting
- Residential interior painting for bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, hallways, and trim.
- High-end surface prep: patching, sanding, priming, and clean masking lines.
- Low-VOC, pet-safe and child-safe paint application.
- Accent wall painting and cabinet refinishing.

### Light Electrical & Fixture Services
- Ceiling fan installation and light fixture replacement into existing junction boxes.
- Swapping outlets, GFCI outlets, dimmers, and Decora light switches.
- Under-cabinet LED lighting and ring motion floodlight installation.
- Smart doorbell (Ring/Nest) and smart lock mounting.

### Fixture-Level Plumbing Services
- Faucet, sink, and showerhead replacement.
- Toilet replacement, bidet installation, and valve line updates.
- Garbage disposal installation and trap leak repairs.

## 3. Flat-Rate Per-Project Pricing Model (No Hourly Rates)

Here Handyman does NOT charge by the hour. All work is priced on a transparent, flat-rate per-project basis with zero hidden fees, zero dispatch surcharges, and zero open-ended hourly meters:
- **No Hourly Clocks**: Homeowners never have to worry about ticking hourly meters or drawn-out labor. You know the exact total before we begin.
- **100% Free Upfront Estimates**: David evaluates each job's specific requirements (wall type, ceiling height, hardware) and provides a clear, guaranteed quote.
- **Photo Estimates**: Homeowners can text photos of their project directly to (516) 350-0801 for a quick, accurate flat-rate estimate.
- **Fair & Transparent**: Upfront quotes include all labor and standard installation hardware. No surprise travel fees or dispatch fees across Westchester County.

---

## 4. Explicit Service Boundaries & Scope Exclusions

Here Handyman is a dedicated, insured residential handyman service. To ensure absolute compliance and customer safety, service boundaries are explicitly defined as follows:

### What Is IN SCOPE (What We Do):
- All standard residential handyman repairs, installations, assembly, and mounting.
- Fixture-level plumbing swaps (faucets, toilets, bidets, garbage disposals, sink valves).
- Fixture-level electrical swaps (light fixtures, ceiling fans, outlets, GFCI, switches into existing wiring).
- Surface prep, drywall patching, interior/exterior trim painting, wainscoting, and crown molding.
- Flat-pack furniture, trampoline, pergola, and outdoor play structure assembly.

### What Is OUT OF SCOPE (Explicit Exclusions):
- **Major Electrical**: No main panel replacements, no 100A to 200A service drop upgrades, no new whole-home circuit runs (requires a licensed master electrician).
- **Major Plumbing & Gas**: No main sewer line excavations, no municipal water line taps, no natural gas or propane line work (requires a licensed master plumber).
- **Structural Engineering**: No load-bearing wall removal or foundation beam alterations.
- **Whole Roof Tear-Offs**: No full roof replacement (gutter clearing and minor fascia repair are supported).
- **HVAC Refrigerant**: No central AC compressor refrigerant charging (requires EPA certification).

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is the estimate really free?**
A: Yes. 100% free with no obligation. You receive a firm flat-rate price before any work begins.

**Q: Does Here Handyman offer same-day service?**
A: Yes, same-day and next-day appointments are frequently available for urgent repairs, TV mounting, and furniture assembly. Call or text (516) 350-0801 for immediate availability.

**Q: Can Here Handyman assemble IKEA PAX wardrobes in Westchester co-ops?**
A: Absolutely. David is highly experienced with complex IKEA PAX configurations and accustomed to working within strict co-op building rules, elevator schedules, and noise hours.
